findings.text: follow-on: the summary says the run covers "the sixteen node ids ... that is red on main", but at main only fifteen of the sixteen are red -- test_closed_form_resolution_probe[limited] passes in 63-66 s at every revision (out-1290186/results.tsv) and is counted into the red set, so the sentence describes the set that was run rather than the set that is red.

follow-on: the tests: line is a prose description of the measurement job rather than the literal command a shell was handed, so the gate receipt cannot be re-run from this line; the underlying per-id commands are recorded in each log header (out-1290186/logs) but the manifest does not lift one into the field promotion reads.

justifications.reuse: no code is added; a capability search over docs/research and docs/evidence/fragments for an existing classification of these tests found prior fragments that mention test_topology_read but none that attributes its redness, so this document is the first owner of that capability.
